AboutPage.heroTitle: Njengoba uBaba engithumile, nami nginithuma kanjalo.
AboutPage.paragraph1: I-Apostolos Missions International (AM) iyinkonzo ehlanganisa amabandla ezinikele ekusakazeni ivangeli kuze kufike emikhawulweni yomhlaba, ifakaza ngothando lweNkosi olungunaphakade.
AboutPage.paragraph2: (ἀπόστολος) igama lesiGreki elisho umphostoli. Lisho "lowo othunywe ngomsebenzi" noma "isithunywa". Isiqu esithi "umphostoli" sivela kaningi eTestamenteni Elisha sibhekisela kubafundi abayishumi nambili abakhethwa nguJesu (Mathewu 10:2, Marku 3:14, Luka 6:13, IzEnzo 2:42). UPawulu, owayekade eshushisa ubuKristu wabe esebamemezeli omkhulu wevangeli, wazethula njengomphostoli (Roma 1:1, 1 Korinte 1:1, 2 Korinte 1:1, Galathiya 1:1, Kolose 1:1, 1 Thimothewu 1:1, 2 Thimothewu 1:1, Thithu).
AboutPage.paragraph3: Abaphostoli yilabo abathunywa yiNkosi ukuba bafeze umsebenzi wokushumayela uJesu Kristu nokwazisa uNkulunkulu kuyo yonke indalo. Isisekelo somBhalo sobuphostoli sitholakala emazwini amaningi eNkosi eyakhetha abaphostoli bokuqala yabathuma njengezithunywa ezithunyelwe ukumela izizwe. Abaphostoli baqonda ukuthi ukuphila kwabo kwakungasekona okwabo, kodwa babephilela ukubonakalisa inkazimulo kaKristu kulo mhlaba owile.
AboutPage.blockquote: UJohane 20:21 uthi: "UJesu wabuye wathi kubo: 'Ukuthula makube kini! Njengoba uBaba engithumile, nami nginithuma kanjalo.'"
AboutPage.paragraph4: I-AM ifisa ukulandela isiko labaphostoli abaphila njengabantu abathunyelwe ukushumayela iZwi likaNkulunkulu. Ngamunye wethu naye uyalithola leli bizo kuNkulunkulu lokuthunyelwa emhlabeni njengezandla nezinyawo zaKhe. Sifisa ukunikela ukuphila kwethu ekulandeleni izinyathelo zikaJesu nasekushumayeleni iVangeli kuze kufike emikhawulweni yomhlaba.
AboutPage.paragraph5: Njengoba ukuphila kwethu kuthintwe futhi kwaguqulwa yiNkosi, sifisa ukubonakalisa uthando lweNkosi esalubonisiwe, sibe yisikhanyiso kubo bonke abantwana bakhe abalahlekile nakubafowethu nodadewethu.

GetInvolvedHub.connectStep1Body: Zikhona izindlela eziningi zokuhlala uxhumene ne-AM. Ungabhalisela iwebhusayithi yethu eyinhloko, i-www.amintl.org, uthole izincwadi zezindaba. Noma ungabhalisela iwebhusayithi yesikole sethu seBhayibheli sase-inthanethi, i-www.amacademy.org, uthole izindaba nezinhlelo zakamuva. Bheka ngokukhululeka umbono wethu, imisebenzi nezinhlelo zethu ngamawebhusayithi ethu, futhi usithumele i-imeyili noma nini uma unemibuzo.
GetInvolvedHub.connectStep2BodySuffix: lapha uma ufuna ukukhuluma nomunye wabasebenzi bethu futhi uthole ukweluleka ohambweni lwakho lomoya. Ungaqoka isikhathi sokuhlangana noma uxhumane nathi ngqo. Abaningi babasebenzi bethu bayazi impilo yasekhampasi futhi bayaziqonda izimo abafundi ababhekana nazo. Bazokusiza uthole indlela efanele kakhulu ohambweni lwakho lokholo.
GetInvolvedHub.connectStep3BodyPrefix: Uma usukulungele ukuqala uhlelo lwethu lokufunda iBhayibheli,
GetInvolvedHub.connectStep3BodySuffix: kuleli khasi. Uma ungatholi isikhathi esikufanele, thumela ifomu lesicelo ubhale isifundo nesikhathi osikhethayo!
GetInvolvedHub.connectStep4BodyPrefix: Uma ufuna ukuxhumana nehhovisi nabasebenzi begatsha lendawo, sicela
GetInvolvedHub.growIntro: Njengoba sikhula futhi sivuthwa ngezigaba ezahlukene zobuntwana, sifinyelela nezinqophamlando ezibalulekile ekuvuthweni kwethu komoya. I-AM inikeza izinhlelo neziqondiso eziningi ezenzelwe ukuhola abafundi kulezi zigaba ezintathu ezibalulekile zokukhula komoya:
GetInvolvedHub.rebornBody: Sizalwa kabusha ngomhlatshelo kaJesu wokubuyisana esiphambanweni.
GetInvolvedHub.matureBody: Siyakhula futhi sivuthwe ngokomoya ngokondliwa ngothando neqiniso elivela kuJesu.
GetInvolvedHub.fruitfulBody: Sizwa ukuthela izithelo kokuphila ngesibusiso sikaNkulunkulu, esigcwaliseka ebunyeni bethu obuvuthiwe noKristu Jesu.
GetInvolvedHub.navigatingBody: Impilo yasekhampasi iyajabulisa futhi iyagcwalisa, kodwa ngenxa yezinketho eziningi ingase futhi ibonakale ingenaqondiso. Ngeqiniso nangomkhuleko, i-AM ikusiza ukuqonda intando kaNkulunkulu futhi uthole isiqondiso esicacile empilweni yakho eyingqayizivele.
GetInvolvedHub.nextStepsBody: Qhubeka ubambe iqhaza ezinhlelweni zethu — sebenzisa amathuba amaningi okuzwa iZwi, ukukhuleka ndawonye, ukuhlanganyela nabafowenu nodadewenu ekukholweni, nokukhonza ngenkathi ukhula eVangelini.
GetInvolvedHub.leadStep1Body: Njengoba sikhula, sifisa ukukhonza labo abadinga usizo ukuze beze kuJesu. Futhi njengoba sikhonza, nathi siyakhula ngokujulile othandweni lukaKristu.
GetInvolvedHub.leadStep2Body: UJesu wathi: "Kubusisiwe ukupha kunokwamukela" (IzEnzo 20:35). Ukuhola nokweluleka abanye kudinga ukuhlakanipha, umkhuleko, ukuzidela nokubekezela. Nokho kuyindawo ebusisiwe, lapho inkazimulo yesiphambano ifinyelela esicongweni.
GetInvolvedHub.leadStep3Body: Nakuba abafundi besebasha, izipho namakhono avelele angatholakala futhi athuthukiswe ngamandla amakhulu ngezikhundla zobuholi. Kuyinqubo enhle lapho umfundi ngamunye ehlola futhi eqinisekisa izipho zakhe zasezulwini ngokuhlangenwe nakho kwomusa kokukhonza nokuhola.
GetInvolvedHub.leadStep4Body: I-AM inikeza abafundi amathuba nezindima ezahlukene zokubamba iqhaza enkonzweni nasebuholini. Joyina iqembu lethu lamavolontiya, abasebenzi begatsha, abaholi begatsha, othisha beBhayibheli nabanye abaningi. Thola lokho uJesu akutshale kuwe ngokwecebo lakhe elihle.
GetInvolvedHub.sentParagraph1: Ukuthweswa iziqu kuyisiqalo esinye esibalulekile sohambo oluya emhlabeni ovulekile phambi kwethu. Abanye bethu bangaqhubeka nezifundo noma bakhethe umkhakha womsebenzi. Abanye baba ngabasebenzi be-AM besikhathi esigcwele, izithunywa noma abefundisi, belandela ubizo lukaNkulunkulu.
GetInvolvedHub.sentParagraph2: Kulesi sinyathelo esibalulekile, i-AM inikeza izinhlelo ozohlala uxhumene ngazo futhi uqhubeke ukhonza umsebenzi weVangeli nge-Alumni Connect. I-AM inikeza futhi izinhlelo zokuqeqeshwa neziqondiso zokuba yisisebenzi sezithunywa esiqeqeshiwe kwi-AM World Mission.
GetInvolvedHub.sentParagraph3: Kunezinketho eziningi ezivulekile phambi kwakho eziya ekusaseni eliqhakazile. I-AM ifisa ukuhamba eduze nawo wonke umuntu ukuze sifeze ndawonye uMyalo Omkhulu: "Ngakho hambani nenze izizwe zonke abafundi, nibabhapathize egameni likaYise neleNdodana nelikaMoya oNgcwele" (Mathewu 28:19).

BibleStudyProgram.heading: Indlela yezigaba ezi-5 kusukela embuzweni wokuqala kuze kube sekuthunyweni.
BibleStudyProgram.description: Uhlelo lwe-AM Lokufunda IBhayibheli lwezigaba ezi-5 luwuhlelo lwe-inthanethi lokwenza abafundi nemfundo yeBhayibheli oluhola abafundi ngendlela ehlelekile yokufunda iVangeli likaJesu Kristu nempilo yokholo. Uhlelo luhlanganisa abafundi nothisha beBhayibheli abafundisa ngokwesikhathi somlaleli. Luphetha ngethuba lokuvolontiya, lokuqeqeshwa njengomfundi oyisithunywa, noma nje lokungena kakhulu eZwini likaNkulunkulu ne-AM.
